sentences.text:
It is further alleged that the petitioner No. 2 with the help of petitioner No. 3 took away Rs. 12,000/-
from the drawer of the Clinic resulting complainant in total loss of Rs. 1,50,000/- (One Lakh Fifty Thousand).
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent and they have falsely been implicated in this case.

It is submitted that the petitioner No. 1 is the wife of the complainant,
petitioner No. 2 is the father-in-law of the complainant and petitioner No. 3 is the brother of the petitioner No. 1.

It is further submitted that the marriage of petitioner No. 1 and complainant was solemnized on 12.02.2018 at Kolkata, and at the time of marriage the father of the complainant demanded Rs. 22,00,000/- (Twenty Two Lakhs) but the father of the petitioner No. 1 was agreed to pay only Rs. 15,00,000/- (Fifteen Lakhs), accordingly, he paid Rs. 15,00,000/- (Fifteen Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.50766 of 2023(3) dt.19-08-2023 Lakhs) with several ornaments, gifts and house utensils.

After marriage, the complainant regularly started torturing the petitioner No. 1 in drunken condition and snatched all the belongings ornaments, all educational certificate, Passbook,
Passport etc. and also tried to kill her, due to which she filed a case against the complainant and his family members at Kolkata vide Parnasree P.S. Case No. 31 of 2020 under Section 498A, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code which is pending for trial.

It is further submitted that prior to Parnasree P.S. Case No. 31 of 2020, petitioner No. 1 has also filed a case under Section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 on 11.02.2022 bearing case No. A.C. 428 of 2020 in the Court of Addl. Chief Magistrate, Alipore, South Pragana (West Bengal) which is pending in the Court of 9th J.M., Alipore (S) Pragana (West Bengal).

Family Court.

sentences.text: Further, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.50766 of 2023(3) dt.19-08-2023 it is submitted that there is a family dispute between both the parties.

Lastly, it has been submitted that father of the complainant filed a complaint case at Motihari against petitioner Nos. 1, 2 and 3 bearing Complaint Case No. 1174 of 2020, in which cognizance has been taken under Sections 323,
379, 448 and 504 of the Indian Penal Code and all the petitioners have been granted bail in the said case.
5. Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioners.

6. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and submissions of learned counsel for the parties, in the event of arrest / surrender of the petitioners within a period of six weeks from today, in connection with Complaint Case No. 1386 (C) of 2020, they shall be released on anticipatory bail upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court of Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class Court No. 7, Patna, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.

P.C.
